name: Megamania in Louisville 2024

venue.name: University of Louisville Event and Conference Center at Shelby Campus

information:
This competition is going to be on the second floor of the Founders Union building on the UofL Shelby campus. To get there you can take the outside stairs or the elevator inside. There will be a table inside where you can pick up your group sheet.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
